threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'shop' instead of a 'corner shop' when you pop down for a pint of milk. The locals know better.
Caught the N199 last night—two blokes arguing over a half-eaten kebab. One insisted it was 'a culinary masterpiece'. Only in Bromley, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw a guy skateboarding past a woman feeding pigeons, while a street musician belted out 'Wonderwall' on the corner. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a hidden rooftop garden bar tucked between old buildings, where locals sip cocktails while the trains rumble by below.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they know which BART stops avoid during game nights — and can spot the tourists still confused by ticket machines.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last night, I saw a guy on the 31 Balboa serenading everyone with a ukulele. Muni delays turned into a mini concert. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists miss how we actually use the same streets for fiestas that we navigate every day. They think it's all just for show, but it’s part of our life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they stare at the metro map like it's a treasure map, looking for something that doesn't exist.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'going to the pub' means ordering a Carlsberg. Anyone who’s local knows it’s all about the craft ales from the tap.
Caught the 68 last night; a guy was serenading the driver with an old soul track. Only in Brixton do you get a late-night concert on the bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted an old Kreuzberg graffiti artist teaching kids how to spray paint on a Neukölln wall. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can buy currywurst at late-night kiosks while standing next to a hipster DJ spinning vinyl. Only in Kreuzberg do street food and nightlife collide like this.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only true locals know that the noise from Civic Center at night isn't just the buskers, but the sound of BART problems echoing through the streets.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 with a guy playing a sax solo. The whole bus went quiet, like we were in a jazz club for a minute. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' means just Gaudí. They miss local gems like Plaça del Sol, where real life happens, far from the tourist trails.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a newcomer by their baffled expressions while trying to decipher the local bus schedules - especially during a transit strike.
